scope: Provisional literature claim map for near-term DESI BAO/AP and thermodynamic-gravity checks. This is not the shared project claim map and does not assert computational reproduction.

claims.statement: The compressed DR2 BAO observable constrains transverse/radial distances relative to the drag sound horizon, not H0 separately; without an early-time ruler calibration, report H0*rd or equivalent.

primary_evidence.locator: Printed pp. 4-5, Eqs. (1)-(5); Sec. VII, pp. 23-25; released 13-vector/covariance.
Eq. (26), printed around p. 20, reports DM/rd and DH/rd.

claims.counterevidence_or_limit: CMB/BBN or another explicit pre-recombination calibration can determine rd and then H0, but that is an additional model/data assumption.
claims.experiment_implication: Use an independent ruler-amplitude parameter for BAO-only fits; distinguish background screening from a calibrated CMB/BBN posterior.

claims.statement: The DESI collaboration reports a CPL improvement over flat LCDM, but its quoted sigma values are profile/effective Delta-chi-square comparisons conditional on the data combination, CMB likelihood, parameterization, priors and two-extra-parameter conversion; they are not Bayesian model odds.
claims.status: reported-result confirmed in full text; interpretation bounded
claims.confidence: high for what paper reports; moderate for cross-analysis comparison

primary_evidence.locator: Printed Table VI p. 24 and adjacent definition; DESI+CMB Delta-chi2_MAP=-12.5 (3.1 sigma), with SN combinations spanning 2.8-4.2 sigma.
Table I p. 5 prior domain; Secs. II-III describe model/data/CMB branches.

claims.counterevidence_or_limit: The extended-DE paper is a companion collaboration analysis rather than independent confirmation. The DR2 paper notes CMB lensing shifts the model comparison relative to compressed early-universe priors.
claims.experiment_implication: State profile versus posterior/evidence metric explicitly; match parameter bounds, SN compilation, covariance, CMB constituent likelihoods and nuisance treatment for any comparison.

claims.statement: Published DR2-era evolving-DE preferences vary materially with SN calibration, CMB/data combination, BAO representation and inference/prior choices; the evidence record supports sensitivity testing rather than a single invariant significance.
claims.status: supported by multiple analyses of overlapping data; not a new independent observation

primary_evidence.locator: Table VI p. 24: 2.8 sigma for Pantheon+, 3.8 sigma Union3, 4.2 sigma DESY5 when combined with CMB.
Tables 10-11: updated DES sample gives 3.2 sigma profile preference and weak (~5:1) Bayesian preference under that paper's convention.
Full HTML read; independent SimpleMC/dynesty reanalysis reports more modest roughly 1.1-2.3 sigma late-time-only evidence across its combinations.
Full HTML read; alternative directional parameterization emphasizes transverse-distance agreement with Planck.

claims.counterevidence_or_limit: These studies share DESI and/or overlapping SN inputs and differ in likelihood/prior/metric; they do not form statistically independent confirmations or corrections. Wang-Mota and the historical SN-systematics paper are abstract-only in this pass.
claims.experiment_implication: Treat same-likelihood LCDM/wCDM/CPL fits as a discriminating baseline, then run prior-boundary and data-branch sensitivities. Do not average published sigma values.

claims.statement: DES-Dovekie is an updated cross-calibration, SALT retraining and systematic treatment of the DES-SN5YR-era data, with a materially updated cosmological result; it is not independent of original DES-SN5YR and overlaps other low-z compilations.

primary_evidence.locator: Secs. 3-5 on calibration; N=1820 and 1718 overlaps in sample comparison; Table 11 on cosmology/model preference.
Current release README says Dovekie supersedes original results and provides distances/covariance/systematic products.

claims.counterevidence_or_limit: The repository branch is mutable and no commit was pinned here; SN overlap with Pantheon+/Union3 also requires explicit source-level accounting.
claims.experiment_implication: Use one SN branch at a time; freeze repo version and validate exact distance/covariance ordering before claiming likelihood reproduction.

claims.statement: ACT MFLike full spectra, ACT-lite and P-ACT are distinct alternative likelihood representations/combinations; P-ACT includes selected Planck spectra with cuts to address sky overlap, and must not be multiplied by constituent ACT/Planck products.

primary_evidence.locator: Eq. (17) p. 22 (1651 full multi-frequency bandpowers), Eq. (33) p. 25 (135 ACT-lite bandpowers), Sec. 6.3 pp. 26-27 (P-ACT Planck overlap cuts).
NASA LAMBDA DR6.02 data and likelihood product inventory.

claims.counterevidence_or_limit: The DR2 paper's default CMB likelihood already includes Planck spectra plus ACT/Planck lensing; a P-ACT or ACT posterior is not independent of those constituents.
claims.experiment_implication: Write a CMB likelihood contract naming the exact ACT and Planck factors; choose one valid composition and avoid posterior-times-constituent reuse.

claims.statement: DESI DR2 Results IV reports a roughly 1% Ly-alpha AP ratio and combined sub-percent distance ratios at z_eff=2.33; it is a valuable high-redshift geometry check, but shares DR2 Ly-alpha spectra/quasar correlations with the earlier Ly-alpha BAO point.
claims.confidence: high for paper's measurements/sample relationship; moderate for external combination recipe

primary_evidence.locator: Eqs. (24)-(26), printed pp. 18-20; Sec. VI results pp. 22-27; Data Availability p. 30.
Full-text read; earlier Results I measurement is BAO from same DR2 Ly-alpha sample family.
Full-text validation companion on mocks/data splits; same survey collaboration/sample.

claims.counterevidence_or_limit: The exact public joint full-shape likelihood/covariance URL was not found in this pass. Results IV's author analysis combines updated Ly-alpha fullshape with galaxy/quasar BAO rather than adding a duplicate old Ly-alpha row.
claims.experiment_implication: For first-pass BAO screening use either the released 13-entry DR2 Gaussian vector or the official Results IV replacement/joint product, never both Ly-alpha representations as independent.

claims.statement: For prescribed density rho, constant K, D=ell^2/tau and positive u=exp(-K phi), the printed TG evolution equation transforms exactly to u_t=D[laplacian(u)+4 pi G K rho u]; the stationary equation is linear in u.
claims.status: algebraic identity from full-text-checked primary equation; not a literature novelty claim
claims.confidence: high for chain-rule identity; physical interpretation remains conditional

primary_evidence.locator: Eq. (1) p. 2, locally visually checked in supplied journal PDF.
Spherical/stationary equations Eqs. (2), (5)-(8) pp. 3-4.

claims.counterevidence_or_limit: This does not prove positivity/stability, solve coupled matter dynamics, establish transformed boundary equivalence, or make the theory observationally successful. At K=0 use Poisson equation directly.
claims.experiment_implication: Implement an independent transformed solver with boundary conditions derived from phi conditions; test positivity, synthetic solutions, K->0 and sign conventions.

claims.statement: The paper's NGC 3198 comparison is a conditional spherical surrogate fit, not a predictive whole-galaxy or isolated-boundary test: it fits K and a stellar mass-to-light factor while imposing observed inner and outer velocity values as derivative boundary conditions.

primary_evidence.locator: Numerical scheme Eqs. (34)-(42), pp. 7-8; Eqs. (41)-(42) use observed endpoint velocities; text says spherical Upsilon is not strictly physical.
Sec. 3.2 NGC 3198 and fit description, pp. 8-9; paper calls it proof of concept.
Secs. 2 and 5 on disk geometry/mass models and stellar mass-to-light uncertainties.

claims.counterevidence_or_limit: This assessment concerns the paper's stated method; it does not independently rerun or refute the conditional numerical fit. SPARC velocity components do not uniquely define a 3D density.
claims.experiment_implication: If reproducing, label as conditional reproduction and use the same endpoint conditions; predictive tests require an exterior condition not set by held-out velocities and whole-galaxy holdout.

claims.statement: Thermodynamic/dissipative extended Newtonian gravity and nonlinear crossover solutions predate the supplied 2024 galaxy application; a later higher-gradient thermodynamic-gravity proposal is a distinct direct follow-up. Broad novelty claims about the framework, relaxation principle or vacuum crossover are therefore unsupported by this first-pass literature record.
claims.status: literature-only; two predecessor sources abstract-only; recent follow-up full text read
claims.confidence: moderate for existence of prior art; low for fine-grained priority claims

primary_evidence.locator: arXiv:1912.00252 v2 abstract and metadata only.
arXiv:2205.05170 v1 abstract only.
Full local text read; different higher-gradient/nonlocal weak-field model.

claims.counterevidence_or_limit: The older predecessor full texts have not been read; do not assert exact equation equivalence or priority from abstracts.
claims.experiment_implication: Restrict claims to a specifically verified transform, numerical boundary-value formulation, or out-of-sample predictive test after reading predecessor full texts.

claims.statement: The available BAO, Ly-alpha, SN and CMB evidence has representations and shared components that make naive multiplication unsafe; a joint likelihood contract is required before combining probes.

primary_evidence.locator: Official 13-entry vector includes Ly-alpha; official CMB bundle described in chain README.
Uses same Ly-alpha DR2 sample family and updated combination.
Overlap with original DES-SN5YR and common low-z compilations.
P-ACT includes Planck cuts; alternative compressed ACT likelihoods.

claims.counterevidence_or_limit: Some official released combination products already construct a defensible joint likelihood under stated assumptions; do not infer that all cross-probe combinations are invalid.
claims.experiment_implication: List each observational factor, source release, covariance/conditional-independence assumption, shared data and duplicate representation before any joint score.
